description_en: Retrieve UV data by domain name
description_zh: 获取 vs 域名 uv 数据
name: DescribeVsDomainUvData

parameters.help_en: The domain name of Visual Edge Computing Service
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The minimum data granularity is 1 hour.
If you do not set this parameter, data from the last 24 hours is queried.
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
最小数据粒度为1小时
不写默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间需大于起始时间；获日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between data records. Unit: seconds. This is a static field with a value of 3600, which indicates 1 hour
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位，固定值1小时

DomainName.description_en: The domain name of Visual Edge Computing Service

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range
